name: Tailwind Components
description: A comprehensive collection of 100 production-ready Tailwind CSS component variants organized into 10 categories.

categories.name: Navigation
categories.description: Navbar, sidebar, breadcrumb, and pagination components

categories.name: Buttons & Actions
categories.description: Specialized button components including gradient, glass, icon, and animated buttons

categories.name: Cards
categories.description: Profile, product, pricing, testimonial, and analytics cards

categories.name: Forms
categories.description: Login, register, multi-step forms, inputs, date pickers, and file uploads

categories.name: Feedback & Status
categories.description: Toast notifications, alerts, progress bars, spinners, and dialogs

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: Hero sections, pricing tables, testimonials, CTAs, and landing page components

categories.name: Dashboard
categories.description: Analytics cards, charts, tables, activity feeds, and settings panels

categories.name: Media & Content
categories.description: Galleries, sliders, players, avatars, ratings, and social share buttons

categories.name: Modern UI / Effects
categories.description: Glassmorphism, bento grids, animated gradients, spotlight effects, and hover reveals

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements include visible focus rings

contributionGuide: See individual component README.md files for contribution guidelines
